note: W2.4 curated free/local models per job (docs/FREE_MODELS.md). minGb = graphics memory (or a Mac's share of memory) the model needs; cpuRamGb = memory to run it on the processor (missing = not suggested without a graphics card). Licenses as published on each model's page on the date above.

models.name: Gemma 3 4B

models.name: Qwen 2.5 VL 7B
